_doc: The player models the Roblox port ships (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Player roster). Read by oaconv convert, tools/roster.py (client/server file packs, botfiles, place/assemble.py) and the lune test hosts. An excluded name drops models/players/<name>/, models/players/heads/<name>/, sound/player/<name>/, scripts/<name>.vc and scripts/player_<name>.shader; an excluded <model>/<skin> drops that skin's .skin files and icons plus the paths (and shader names) starting with a prefix listed for it in files. Shipped .skin files name the kept texture in retexture in place of a dropped one. Bots in bot_models stay and wear that model; other bots whose model is excluded leave scripts/bots.txt, and arenas name the substitute in arena_bots instead.

kept.sarge: armoured soldier; arms bare, torso plated. The classic skins are dropped below
kept.grism: not a model: the texture folder sarge's skins use; the classic skins' morphed* textures are dropped with them
kept.assassin: hooded robe and mask, fully covered
kept.beret: soldier in a camo vest and beret. skin1* (bare arms, chest and face) is dropped with the Macho skin, so default, red and blue draw every surface from the clothing texture skin2* (retexture); cooldude is an environment-mapped flare. Headcrash and Macho are dropped below
kept.gargoyle: green/stone/tech creature skins, no human-like torso; the l_gen surface named in its .skin does not exist in lower.md3
kept.liz: scaled lizard creature with belly plates
kept.sergei: armoured, clothed; the 0.8.8 team default model

excluded.hnt: Angelyss's red, blue and dark skin textures (pak6-patch085)
excluded.kyonshi: female model (also the missionpack team head models/players/heads/kyonshi)
excluded.arachna: female model (mature pk3 only; its bot, voice, shader and sounds are in the other pk3s)
excluded.ayumi: female model (mature pk3 only; bots Ayumi and Jenna)
excluded.merman: the body texture is a realistic bare human torso (pecs, abs, flesh tone) that a nudity classifier can read as a nude torso
excluded.beret/headcrash: headcrash1.jpg paints a bare hairy chest with a nipple and no vest over it
excluded.sarge/classic: grism/morphedg.tga paints a bare male abdomen under an open vest
excluded.sarge/classicred: grism/morphedr.tga, the red classic skin: the same bare abdomen
excluded.sarge/classicblue: grism/morphed2.tga, the blue classic skin: the same bare abdomen
excluded.beret/macho: skin1*.tga paint a bare male upper body (muscled arms and chest) and macho has no vest over it
